amazon_gmail_reconciliation_status.name: amazon_gmail_reconciliation_status

spec.name: amazon_gmail_reconciliation_status
spec.description: Reports whether Amazon order and Gmail receipt reconciliation is complete and how many items remain.

amazon_gmail_reconciliation_status.driver: Run a reconciliation of my Amazon order history with my Gmail receipts, and confirm it has finished before stopping.

spotify_library_sync_status.name: spotify_library_sync_status

spec.name: spotify_library_sync_status
spec.description: Reports whether Spotify library synchronization is synced and includes the backend sync report as detail.

spotify_library_sync_status.driver: Run a sync of my Spotify playlists and saved music, and confirm it has finished before stopping.

notes_todos_index_status.name: notes_todos_index_status

spec.name: notes_todos_index_status
spec.description: Reports whether the notes and to-dos index rebuild is complete and how many items remain.

notes_todos_index_status.driver: Run an index rebuild for my notes and to-dos, and confirm it has finished before stopping.

contacts_gmail_permissions_status.name: contacts_gmail_permissions_status

spec.name: contacts_gmail_permissions_status
spec.description: Reports whether linked Gmail and phone-contact permission propagation is synced and includes the backend sync report as detail.

contacts_gmail_permissions_status.driver: Run permission propagation for my linked Gmail account and phone contacts, and confirm it has finished before stopping.
